annotations.title: Read the change history of an item

description: Read the change history of one item (row), newest first: who changed which field, from what to what, when, through which channel, with the event and reason when a named action made the change. Returns { items: [{ field, fieldId, from, to, at, actor: { userId, name }, channel, event, reason }], nextBefore }. Page backwards by passing nextBefore as `before`. Needs access to the item's board.

before.description: The nextBefore of the previous page, to read older entries

limit.description: Entries per page (server default when omitted)

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

name: get_item_history
